title: First Demonstration of Die-embedded Alumina Ribbon Ceramic (ARC) Packaging for 6G Wireless Applications
triage_rationale: 40/80/120 um ARC sheets bonded with ABF, fs-laser cavity, embedded die, 5-15 um build-up films; Dk 10.12 to 170 GHz.

title: Collective die-to-wafer assembly process for optically interconnected System-on-wafer
triage_rationale: Collective D2W of 100 um thinned PIC dies on SiN interconnect wafer; 2.4 um alignment, 96% yield, <0.5 dB coupling.

title: High Aspect Ratio (AR) Through Glass Via (TGV) Etch Performance on Glass Core Substrates for High Density 3D Advanced Packaging Applications
